Arsenal Signs Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle

Premier League club Arsenal has completed the signing of midfielder Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United. Newcastle stated they did not wish to sell the player. Guimaraes, a Brazil international, has signed a four-year contract with an option for an additional year. The reported transfer fee is approximately $101 million.
